AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming cleaning.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundry: Stain Removal? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundry: Stain Removal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundry: Stain Removal.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundry: Stain Removal.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laundry: Stain Removal.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

18. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo? (1 mark)

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
